Conversational Recommender Systems (CRSs) are developed to proactively engage users with interactive dialogues to understand user preferences and provide highly personalized recommendations.

quote: Evaluation Metrics Following the literature , the Success Rate (SR) is adopted to measure the ratio of successful recommendations within T max turns; Average Turn (AT) to evaluate the average number of conversational turns; and hDCG to evaluate the ranking order of the ground-truth item among the list of all the recommended items.
